- **trap** `ai/state-which-platform-faults-were-live`: State which platform faults were live when drawing conclusions from a benchmark round, and rebaseline when its harness changes. Check the measuring instrument before attributing a defect to model capability.
- **rule** `ai/measure-defect-dimension-before-claiming-deterministic`: Measure a defect's dimension before claiming a deterministic gate catches it; otherwise forbid the construct. Do not equate a machine-valid template with a good graphic.
- **rule** `ai/read-before-proposing-apparently-new-approach`: Read `docs/AI_ATTEMPTS.md` before proposing an apparently new AI approach, and distinguish live product paths from experiments and retired mechanisms.
- **rule** `ai/require-harness-earn-reliability-quality-advantage`: Require the harness to earn its reliability and quality advantage over a plain model call in `scripts/ai-compare.mjs`; retain a stage only when its improvement justifies its cost.
